declienting: Removed the cross-bucket imports of Breadcrumbs.helpers and Breadcrumbs.types from components/renderings/page-content/breadcrumbs/. A ui primitive reaching into a rendering component is the coupling that stopped this being reusable; the types now live with the component.
Replaced the BreadcrumbBackArrowIcon import with a backIcon slot, and made the separator a slot too.
Replaced the import of textLinkAnimatedUnderline from the sibling text-link component with the shared src/lib/underline module.
Replaced the [data-theme='dark'] selector coupling with an explicit surface prop, so the variant does not depend on an ancestor the component cannot see.
Replaced the hard-coded 44px mobile tap target with the --size-touch-medium token.
Kept verbatim: the nav landmark with an aria-label, aria-current on the current page, the current page rendered as text rather than a link, and the xl breakpoint collapse to a single back link.
